visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a forward-facing shot from a car driving on a highway, passing blue overhead signs for 'Terminal 3 Perkantoan' and 'Terminal 1 & 2'. Inside the car, the camera shows the dashboard and the driver's hands on the steering wheel. (2) The scene shifts to the airport drop-off zone where people are seen unloading suitcases from a white SUV. The main character, a young man with short dark hair, appears in front of Terminal 3, looking around and gesturing at the architecture. (3) Inside the terminal, the camera pans across the vast check-in area with high, angular ceilings and large display boards. The character and his friend interact at a check-in counter; a close-up shows a blue industrial scale being used for luggage. (4) A sequence of shots shows various shops and restaurants like 'OldTown' and 'Putu Made' within the bright, modern terminal. The character goes through an automatic immigration gate and then takes an escalator down to a lower level. (5) He arrives at the 'Saphire Plaza Premium Lounge' entrance, showing the different signage for First and Business class. Inside the lounge, the camera showcases the buffet area with various covered dishes and a bar with green plants hanging above. (6) The final shots show the two men sitting at a table in the lounge, eating and laughing together.
